items.html: *And behold, what enters first into these vessels to give them life is not the three Names themselves, but their fillings enter first, for they are lower degrees than the Names themselves, as is written in the discourse of the 288 sparks. And behold, the number of the fillings alone of these Names, after the simple Names are removed from them, are these: the filling of AB, when you remove the simple, which is 26 in gematria, leaves 46; and the filling of SAG in the above manner is 37; and the filling of MA in the above manner is 19.
